ns2:course.label: French Active Review II
ns2:course.description: Reviews materials covered in FR 102 and FR 103 in preparation for entrance into FR 104 or FR 134. Not open to students with credit in FR 101, FR 102, FR 103 or FR 105. Open to students with high school French; by placement score or consent of department only. Prerequisite: Three or four years of high school FR with placement at 102 level.
